This poster stand is a good solution for displaying signs, menus, and promotional materials. It was easy to assemble, the height adjustment works well, and the double-sided design is very practical. The base provides decent stability, and the overall appearance is clean and professional. My only criticism is that some parts could feel a bit more solid, especially considering the size of the stand. It works well for indoor use, but I expected slightly better build quality. Overall, it is still a useful product that offers good value for the price, and I would recommend it for shops, hotels, exhibitions, restaurants, and other commercial environments.
